recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-34204; do not fold in FHIR-34205 unless the work group later resolves that separate ServiceRequest status proposal.
issue_request: FHIR-34204 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by OO and requested an STU Observation.triggeredBy backbone element identifying observations that triggered the current observation, with a mandatory Observation reference, mandatory reflex/repeat/re-run type, and optional reason string.
initial_application: The issue was previously applied by commit 351e125bde9b07eb4fca03acf9f02ef2f543698d, which added the Observation.triggeredBy StructureDefinition elements plus the observation-triggeredbytype CodeSystem and ValueSet. Jira's application comment links PR #1776 commit 2c2f2dbc0b59d536a2837427732efb5a46518690, which added RIM mappings, with later cleanup in 2d2e3d3a51d0677b37b908e2b99805f52161ac62 and merge 70db8cfbd0.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists observation=Observation, so the inspected Observation resource files are in current build scope. Current source uses Observation.triggeredBy.observation rather than the proposal's generic reference child name, but it preserves the 1..1 Reference(Observation) semantics. OO minutes record the issue as persuasive/approved, while adjacent FHIR-34205 is still unresolved and concerns ServiceRequest.status. Later Diagnostics module guidance uses Observation.triggeredBy for additional observations.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active StructureDefinition, CodeSystem, and ValueSet already convey the requested semantics and no later conflicting decision was found.
